title: Tropical Suite with Two King Beds w/ Balcony
description: Escape to a tropical paradise in our beautiful 2 king bed suite. Perfect for families or groups of friends with a max capacity of 4 guests. Suite includes a private balcony with a serene view of lush trees and greenery. Room includes a small fridge, coffee machine, TV, Wi-Fi, A/C, and hot water shower. Room is located within a self-catering guesthouse and is accessible by stairs only. Pet-friendly, non-smoking. Additional info on site.The spaceHi! Welcome to Paradise! Please be aware that this unit is not standalone property. Common areas are shared with other guests staying in other rooms. All rooms have private entrances and bathrooms. Please contact us with any questions or concerns. Property includes 2 pools, 3 buildings, free parking spaces, and Wi-Fi. We have no lifeguards on duty in pool areas. We have pet-friendly (pet fee*) rooms, you may see pets in common areas. We also have closed-circuit security cameras recording 24/7 in common areas for your safety. There are no cameras or audio recordings inside any private space of the unit. We are located in a rural area with fully paved roads, close to the beach, restaurants and other places of interest in a hillside surrounded by many trees and nature. It would be best to have a car rental to enjoy this beautiful town. If you have any questions about your room and/or reservation, please contact us through Airbnb inbox. We have staff on site during daytime hours in case you need assistance. Access to room will be sent through inbox around 3-4pm or as soon as the room is ready for use. Any changes must be processed at least 24 hours before arrival date. We have a non-visitor policy. Only registered guests are allowed to enter room or use facilities. Rooms have a maximum of guests. Please read room description before arrival day. Changes upon arrival are not possible most of the time because we have limited spaces. We check and document rooms before giving access. Expect some natural tear and wear of room. A/C’s must be kept on during your stay to prevent excessive moisture inside room. Cristal windows let in light but cannot be open to prevent damage to A/C and unwanted bugs inside room.Guest accessThe room has a lockbox with the key inside next to its door. On Check in date, we will be sending you a code to gain access to your room at any time after 3pm. Our check in time is 3pm and check out time is 11:30am. Please review your information as room cannot be changed on arrival date because of # of people, location, number of beds, or preferences. Cancelations, modifications, or changes of dates must be done 24 hrs before check in date.
amenities: Shared pool - available all year, open specific hours

description: Dinner on the deck? Rooftop BBQ? We’ve spared no expense to make this property an amazing spot to relax or socialize with family and friends. This is for the entire second floor at La Casa Greub, which can accommodate 12 guests. This floor includes a private lounge, hammocks, deck, and dining area for private dining and relaxing. There is a shared rooftop as well with a Bar, ocean views, grill, and areas for hanging out or relaxing, including a net bed, and a mister for hot days!The space2 Minute Walk To The Beach | Newly Renovated | 5 Bedrooms | 12 Guests | 2 full bathrooms | 2 Kitchens (Stove and Microwave) | Private Deck for Lounging/Dining | Shared Access To Rooftop Deck (The Tree House)This villa is located on the second level of La Casa Greub in Stella Rincón, PR. This villa has access to a shared rooftop deck (partially covered) that has a beautiful view of the ocean, mountains, and local vegetation. This villa is within an easy 2 minute walk to the beach.This villa can accommodate up to 12 guests in 2 different units. - Villa 1 - A three bedroom apartment with two rooms that have a queen sized mattress and a room with two twin sized bunk-beds ( 6 beds total).- Villa 2 - A two bedroom apartment with one room that has a queen sized mattress and one room with a bunk-bed that has a twin sized mattresses over a full mattress (3 beds total). A total of 9 beds (3 queens, 5 twins, and 1 full mattress). Each room of the villa has its own air conditioning, heating, ceiling fan, clothing storage, and lamp. There are also two spacious open living/dinning/kitchen areas with a large sectionals and TVs.La Casa Greub consists of 4 separate villas, all of which can be booked separately or in combination.Guest accessYou will have private access to your bedrooms, bathrooms, and open living/dining/kitchen areas. You will also have private access to the entire second floor. There is also plenty of parking on both sides of the property. All guests of La Casa Greub have access to the rooftop deck. Be sure to visit the beautiful rooftop created for socializing, relaxing, and enjoying the beautiful view of the ocean and mountains. The rooftop has a bar, two twin sized day beds, a picnic table, BBQ Grill, refrigerator, sink, bathroom, outdoor furniture, and lounge chairs. There is also an outdoor shower located on the first level to wash off after visiting the beach.There are two different beaches located within a 2 minute walk of the property, no need to drive there.Other things to noteEach villa is accommodated with shampoo, conditioner, body wash, coffee maker, blender, dishes, utensils, soap, and ice trays. We have pots and pans in each Villa.You will have access to a washer and dryer located on the second floor on the terrace. We also have a Graco Pack’n Play crib available upon request.

With direct access to the river, this space invites you to wake up to natural sounds, explore the outdoors, and end your day in complete tranquility.Only a 4-minute drive from Rincon Town Square and a 6-minute drive from the beach.The spaceThe interior offers an intimate, comfortable, and functional setting that includes:• Air conditioning• Full bunk bed• Kitchennette with basic essentials• Private bathroom• Smart TV• Internet 5G high speed • Rooftop Terrace This space is thoughtfully designed for nature lovers and eco-travelers who appreciate simple, genuine experiences while staying connected when needed.Common AreasEnjoy open green spaces, nature, and a basketball court perfect for staying active after a day of exploring, hiking, or enjoying the river.Guest accessThe property includes on-site parking, making access and mobility convenient throughout your stay.Other things to noteOther Things to Note✔ Peaceful environment✔ Ideal for romantic and adventurous getaways✔ Direct connection with nature✔This is a studio, and there is no closet space✔Not wheelchair accessible✔️ Under- bed storage

title: Casa Mabel-Goyita Beachfront-Heart of Rincón
description: Enjoy paradise at Casa Goyita located right on Rincon's famous Lala's Beach and just a quick walk to downtown! Casa Goyita is an 8 Bedroom 4 Bath Duplex that sleeps 20 comfortably and offers a modern interior, spacious high ceilings, AC, WiFi, lovely terrace with outdoor kitchen, direct beach access via private path, shaded pavilion, and outdoor shower for rinsing off.The spaceThe spaceSpacious upstairs and downstairs units each feature two private entrances, one on front, one beach side. Reviews agree there is plenty of space in each for 10 (20 total) to stay in comfort. The most unique aspect is the beautiful backyard that opens directly onto Lala’s beach and one of the best Rincón areas for ocean swimming.Five bedrooms have a Queen bed, One has a Queen and Twin, and two bedrooms have a Queen bed plus Twin/Twin bunk beds. Master bedrooms have in suite bathrooms. Third and Forth bathrooms are off hallway, with an additional outdoor shower in the backyard.Guest accessThe entire house plus terrace, outdoor kitchen, path to beach, ample backyard, and shaded pergola are yours to enjoy.All beaches are public in Puerto Rico, so other beach goers will be on the sand and in their water, however, they can not see beyond the tree line so the backyard and terrace area retains privacy.PARKING.. on property behind the gate are four compact to mid-sized parking spots. Additional street parking is available on the MAIN STREET, wherever the curb is painted white, just a few yards from the house. NO PARKING IS ALLOWED IMMEDIATELY OUTSIDE THE GATE TO THE PROPERTY. We know this isn’t ideal, but please help us keep our neighbors happy by not parking on Calle Cambija.Other things to noteThe house was built in the late 1970’s by Goyita Ruiz. The grounds are still lovingly cared for and maintained by her son, Julio, who often comes by in the late mornings to sweep and tidy the large property and will gladly to give you a local history lesson if you ask. There are free roaming chickens that can create a need to keep up with this. If you prefer during your stay to personally sweep and hose the terrace and walkway, please let us know prior to your check in.

description: This listing includes the whole house, both floors! It has 4 bedrooms, and 4 bathrooms. Two bedrooms have their own private bathrooms. There are two kitchens one on the top level, one on the lower level. Both levels have terraces with beautiful views of the ocean along with a grassy yard area and a patio where you can sit relax with a close view of the ocean. The yard has direct access to the beach and ocean. Our home is close to many restaurants, grocery store, and Rincon’s lively Plaza.The spaceThe house is located on the beach. The rear yard provides direct access to the beach, there is always parking in front of the property. Our terrace has a panoramic view of the ocean featuring Desecheo island in the distance. This is a the perfect place to watch the sunset. Our kitchens are full stocked with anything you may need. Bath towel, soap, shampoo, conditioner, beach towels, beach toys and more. We are located near shopping and restaurants, and bars. We are a 5 minutes drive from the quaint downtown Rincon Plaza. The plaza features shops, restaurants, and bars with fun activities including: the Thursday Art fair, and Sunday morning farmers market.Guest accessGuest access information will be provide within 48 hours of your stay at our home.

title: Sunset Paradise, Villa 4 - Oceanfront -14 guests
description: 7 Bedrooms | 14 Guests | 2 Equipped Kitchens | Terraces At Ground, 2nd & 3rd Levels | Direct Access To The Seashore | 2 BBQ/Grills | 4 Parking Spaces | 2 Private Hot-Tubs | Infinity Pool & Jacuzzi/Spa At Common Rooftop AreaThis is Villa 4, lower and upper levels units, of Sunset Paradise Villas in Stella, Rincon. With 2 jacuzzi/spas, come in, sit back and enjoy time with your friends or loved ones while you take in the best view of the Rincón sunsets and the Caribbean Sea.The spaceIt is an exclusive combination of privacy, comfort and luxury in a privileged location.This unparalleled luxury Villa accommodates up to 14 people in 7 bedrooms. This comfortable Oceanfront Villa, Sunset Paradise - Villa 3, features in both levels a spacious open living/dining/kitchen areas with a large sectional for relaxing or watching TV. In 1st level, Villa Alma, two bedrooms share a complete bathroom, three King bedrooms have a private bath and you will find a fifth bathroom in the Oceanside covered and uncovered patio across the entire back of the Villa. At 2nd level, Villa Camila, you will find Two King Bedrooms with private bathrooms and a big balcony/terrace facing the ocean.Both have a BBQ/Grill, hammock, comfortable patio furniture, and direct access to the seashore. With 2 Jacuzzi/Spas located on the 2nd level terrace and the rooftop, both facing the sea. This is a perfect stay for your family or group of friends looking for a private getaway in the calm and peaceful Caribbean Sea, looking for oceanfront rest or on the beach.Guest accessPrivate access to each Villa, with 4 assigned parking spaces located directly out front.Guests of Sunset Paradise Villas can enjoy the infinity swimming pool located upstairs at rooftop terrace. This is the ideal place to enjoy with with your group the stunning Ocean and Sunsets view. The property also enjoys direct access to the sea shore, and through our sandy beach just beside the property.Other things to noteThe shore of our beach is constantly changing, sometimes it has a lot of sand and sometimes the level drops. But the water is always crystal clear, the bottom is sandy, excellent for water sports, bathing, swimming, snorkeling, kayaking and SUP paddle boarding. Equipment is available for rent at the property.Usually the water is calm, but in occasions where the sea is affected by some weather system.When the sand level drops and access from the property is difficult, we have a sandy beach right next to the property. You don't need to take the car to get there.You could book the whole Sunset Paradise Villas property that counts on eight villas, which also could be booked separately or in combination for 2, 4 ,6 ,8, 10, 14, 18, 22, 28 or up to 50 guests. This is the perfect location for your escape on weekends and holidays, or to celebrate your event.We count with an in-house Events Coordination Service to help you make your celebration unforgettable.
